description: NASA Space Apps Challenge kapsamında, gençlere astronot eğitimini ve uzay aracı tasarımını interaktif simülasyonlarla öğretecek "Genç Astronot Görev Aracı" projemizi geliştiriyoruz. Uzay teknolojileri ve STEM eğitimine tutkuyla bağlı ekibimize; web/oyun geliştirme, UI/UX tasarım, içerik üretimi ve sunum alanlarında yetkin takım arkadaşları aramaktayız. Geleceğin kaşiflerine ilham vermek için başvurularınızı bekleriz.
summary:
We developed an interactive simulation game designed for aspiring young astronauts, allowing them to experience the physical and psychological challenges of a nine-month space mission. Throughout this journey, players make strategic decisions to overcome realistic obstacles such as microgravity effects, resource management, isolation, and critical technical failures.

Our project addresses the challenge of making complex astrophysics and space biology concepts accessible to youth by gamifying the high-stress and unpredictable nature of deep-space missions. Moving beyond theoretical knowledge, it bridges the gap in hands-on space education by fostering practical problem-solving, teamwork, and crisis management skills in a safe virtual environment.

This initiative is crucial for inspiring the next generation of scientists and engineers who will lead future long-duration Moon and Mars expeditions. By empowering young minds to step into the shoes of active problem-solvers rather than passive observers, our simulation builds resilience and cultivates skilled talent for the future of space exploration.
details:
Our project is an interactive educational simulation that lets aspiring young astronauts experience the physical, technical, and psychological challenges of a nine-month deep-space mission. Players manage limited oxygen, water, and energy supplies while making strategic decisions to overcome realistic crises like radiation storms, technical failures, and isolation. By transforming complex space sciences from theoretical memorization into hands-on problem-solving skills, the simulation aims to boost youth interest in STEM fields and inspire future space explorers.

We developed the game using the Unity engine, C# programming language, and Blender for 3D spacecraft environments. Unlike conventional flight simulators, our creative approach places human psychology and survival dynamics at the core of gameplay, blending scientific education with immersive storytelling. Throughout development, our team prioritized scientific accuracy based on NASA’s human spaceflight data, an intuitive user experience tailored for young players, and accessibility to ensure complex concepts remain engaging and understandable for all skill levels.
